hypothesis: On new physical systems, a native tokenless causal-history model predicts factual intervention return-to-go and autonomously selects the CALIBRATE-vs-EXPLOIT action that leads to higher realized future reward, beating blinded native, strong trained conventional policy, and constant/coin baselines on genuinely unseen worlds.
null: If either frozen seed fails minimum paired realized reward advantage or OOD/cold criteria, predeclare DEV_ACTIVE_POLICY_NO_GO; a favorable posterior prediction error or old passive action history alone does not prove active intervention value.

model.native: Original R74 HybridPilot_FULL (16,818,178 parameters) with original hard depth route, R75 exact causal triangular TTT fastweights, no R79 surrogate or R78 learnt weights.
model.blind: Only previous chosen action onehot4 + previous factual observation4 input columns 4..11 zeroed; keep current candidate action and public time.
model.controls: GRU256 learned action-value and MLP256 learned action-value, both trained same genuine logged action-return data, not necessarily matched params/FLOPs.

physics.branch_pivot: Half of fresh worlds fixed EARLY t12 (OOD t16), half COLD_AFTER_A_RETURN t48. Hidden law A->B at 20..27 FIT/DEV and 24..31 OOD, return B->A at36..43 FIT/DEV and 40..47 OOD.
physics.state: Hidden actuator state initialized zero. Previous logged actions can set it: CALIBRATE sets state to current hidden law. PROBE reveals noisy law cue but leaves actuator state. Public policy never sees hidden state directly.
physics.future_actions: After candidate pivot, exactly eight future common EXPLOIT_POS_2 actions, same hidden law and innovations across paired evaluator outcomes, no adaptively selected later actions.
physics.value: CALIBRATE immediate reward -0.5, changes physical state. EXPLOIT_POS current selected reward depends on hidden law sign, whether actuator state matches hidden law, and noise. Correct calibration boosts magnitude, so it can improve positive-law outcomes or harm negative-law outcomes; when already calibrated, calibration cost is wasteful. Future observed consequences are actual effects.
physics.worlds: Fresh independent stochastic hidden state/law/noise, source split disjoint by salts. FIT and FIT_VALIDATION emit ONLY ONE genuinely logged factual pivot action/return for each world. DEV/OOD emit matched two separately realized intervention trajectories to evaluate policy regret; unchosen branch NEVER supplied to model or training loss.
physics.input_features: 13 float32: current chosen action onehot4, previous chosen action onehot4, previous *actually selected* observation4, normalized public time1. At decision agent only receives prefix ending at candidate action, no present/future reward, hidden law, counterfactual or future rollout actions.
physics.outputs: Scalar predicted nine-step causal factual return-to-go from the logged pivot; actual paired evaluator scores based on realized returns after choosing each actual intervention, NOT model prediction alone.

training.data: Same exact FIT logged factual action/9-step return target and same RNG-selected world indices for all four arms, no unchosen action label used. Both native arms start with byte-identical parameter tensors.
training.loss: Masked pivot-only return regression, full causal prefix to pivot available, final loss mean squared nine-step return error.
training.validation: Read-only FIT_VALIDATION64 logged factual worlds; no hyperparameter tuning or first DEV/OOD access before all 4 arms complete 512 updates.

evaluation.first_use: After four full-trained weight sets frozen for each seed, first generate fresh independent DEV128 & OOD128 paired factual physical rollouts; no further training, no model selection from score.
evaluation.choice: At pivot, evaluate two candidate actions by model forward up through and including pivot only, choose argmax predicted nine-step return; execute selected action in independently realized paired evaluator world. No hidden/pair counterfactual outcome available at decision time.
evaluation.policy_metrics: mean actual realized 9-step return; regret to per-world better realized option, chosen-action agreement with better option, across all worlds and cold-return subset; compare actual outcomes, not Q MSE only.

execution.route: existing original G4 workflow, full mandatory dual-platform G4 & G5 & G7 exact SHA, then two seed-isolated first-attempt GitHub-hosted Ubuntu CPU bounded 29min jobs
